overview:
Josh Gottheimer seeks another term in a northern New Jersey district that leans Democratic by about two points. He enters the general election with an enormous financial advantage, having raised $5.5 million and holding $13.4 million on hand, while Republican Sean Kirrane has raised under $100,000 with roughly $9,000 available. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the outlook rests on fundamentals and market pricing.

Prediction markets on Kalshi and Polymarket both put Gottheimer's chances near 96 percent. His incumbency, fundraising edge, and history of double-digit wins in this district point to a comfortable re-election. The main uncertainty is the absence of polling, which leaves room for a closer contest if the national environment breaks sharply against Democrats.
